en-US.author: Rambox LLC
en-US.description: Workspace simplifier - The only way to organize your workspace and boost your productivity
en-US.longDescription: Rambox is a workspace organizer that allows you to unify as many applications as you want, all in one place. It is perfect for those who care about productivity while working with many business and personal apps.
en-US.name: Rambox
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changelog
New
- Sidebar: the "Sidebar layout" setting is now Simple or Advanced. Advanced brings back nested workspaces, up to three levels, as in Rambox 2.
- Sidebar: drag an app onto another to group them into a new sub-workspace, with a live preview.
- Sidebar: pin apps to the first column of the rail, below your workspaces.
- App markers: add a small chip to an app's icon to tell apart two instances of the same app.
- Passkeys, two-factor prompts and security keys now work inside apps on Windows, macOS and Linux, with a passkey autofill list like Chrome's and a security-key prompt that can be cancelled. macOS: passkeys work with Touch ID. Windows: your Windows Hello passkeys are listed. If you use a password manager extension, it handles your passkeys, as in Chrome.
- When a site asks for a client certificate and more than one matches (smart cards, mutual TLS), Rambox asks which one to use.
- Extensions: side panels open to the right of the active app (Bitwarden, Grammarly).
- Extensions: keyboard shortcuts defined by extensions now work. Rambox's own shortcuts take priority when they clash.
- Extensions: password managers can fill a site's sign-in prompt (HTTP authentication).
- Extensions: screen-recording extensions can record a tab, or share a screen, a window or a Rambox app.
- Extensions now use the app's language.
- Proton Pass, MultiPassword, Mailtrack for Gmail, Wordtune, Zoom, Monica, LanguageTool and Awesome Screen Recorder are now available in the extensions catalog.
Improvements
- Upgraded Electron to v45.2.1 (Chromium 156.0.8078.75). :electron:
- The extensions catalog now offers the latest version of every extension, and extensions get the browser features they expect from Chrome.
- A version that is no longer supported now shows the end-of-support screen with the download link when you sign in, instead of an error.
- Dismissing an app's alert (for example, a Google Calendar reminder) now clears the notifications that came with it and updates the app's badge.
- Custom apps without a logo show their first letter on a colored background instead of a "?".
- The app's own tab in the temporary tabs bar shows its name and logo.
- When a link can open in one of your apps, custom apps are offered too, and "Don't ask" is respected when there is only one choice.
- Unified Search: WhatsApp message search works again, and opening a result goes to the chat inside the same app.
- The small status icons on app icons in the sidebar (muted, disabled, hibernated, playing sound, pinned...) are easier to read in light and dark themes.
- You can drag apps and workspaces into and out of the sidebar's "…" panels.
- Screen sharing: only one picker opens at a time, and it shows which app is asking.
- When saving Settings fails, Rambox tells you and keeps the panel open.
- A photo or name changed in the console now shows up in the app.
- Remote Control: the access token is stored encrypted, and Settings > Remote Control shows recent activity.
- Custom apps: icon search also tries sites that only use http://.
- Console: invoices show what was billed and what is still owed, not only what was paid.
- Console: custom branding lets you crop the organization logo, instead of asking for a ready-made 128x128 PNG.
- Console: the light/dark theme choice is remembered.
- Console: the organization owner can join a team or sub-team to get its workspaces, and keeps their own permissions.
- Console: Support keeps the requests of your personal account and your organization accounts apart, and changing your email keeps your requests.
- Console: changing an app's URL, injected code, proxy or user agent in a team workspace now requires Full access to Apps.
- Sign-up: if a name is rejected, the form says which field and why.
- Support: if an email attachment can't be accepted, you get a reply saying which file and why.
Fixes
- Fixed signing in from the browser not completing when your system does not send the sign-in back to the app. If it takes longer than a minute, the waiting screen now explains why and links to a guide.
- Fixed uBlock, LastPass and NordPass not starting at all.
- Fixed uBlock not blocking anything, and the blocking rules of Keeper, 1Password, HubSpot Sales and Streak not being applied.
- Fixed Grammarly not working inside apps.
- Fixed Dashlane not filling in forms.
- Fixed Keeper's in-field prompt closing by itself right after opening.
- Fixed Google Translate's popup translating text selected in another app, and its right-click menu missing.
- Fixed the toolbar icons of HubSpot Sales and Keeper not showing.
- Fixed apps sometimes loading at startup before their extensions were ready (for example, Gmail without HubSpot Sales or Streak).
- Fixed extension popups sometimes opening too small, and their badge text being unreadable.
- Fixed extensions that open a sign-in window from their popup not being able to sign in.
- Fixed buttons missing from extension notifications.
- Fixed the last extensions in the Extensions panel being out of reach when many are installed.
- Fixed extensions on a new profile only loading from the second launch, and removing an extension failing on Windows.
- Windows: Fixed the Microsoft Single Sign On extension not connecting to Windows.
- Windows: Fixed extensions not finding their companion desktop apps when those were installed as 32-bit.
- Fixed a security issue in the screen share picker.
- Fixed zoom shortcuts not working with some keyboard layouts or the numeric keypad, and zooming twice from inside an app.
- Fixed work hours that cross midnight (for example, 15:00 to 01:00) not being accepted.
- Fixed updates being downloaded automatically after a forced update check even with "Automatically download updates" turned off, a download in progress starting over, and an already downloaded update being announced again.
- Fixed Settings changes being lost if the app crashed right after saving.
- Fixed "Add app" in the Command Center doing nothing.
- Fixed custom apps with a large icon not being saved.
- Fixed team members losing their workspace order in the sidebar.
- Fixed notification badges in the sidebar being cut off.
- Fixed the title bar buttons sliding under the minimize button when the window is very narrow or the interface is zoomed out.
- Fixed icons overlapping the text in the in-page search, the sign-in prompt, the Quick Switcher and the app catalog search.
- Fixed workspaces in tiles layout missing from Quick View.
- Fixed windows opened from a popup not behaving like those opened from the app.
- Fixed the app reopening with the previous account's data after being force-closed right after switching accounts.
- Fixed a browser sign-in in progress being cancelled by an unrelated sign-in link.
- Linux: Fixed "Open at startup" crashing the app at login (deb, rpm and tar.gz).
- Linux (Snap, Flatpak): Fixed "Open Rambox at startup" not working. It is on by default, so Rambox will start at login after updating unless you turn it off.
- Linux (deb, rpm): Fixed signing in from the browser not returning to the app when an earlier Rambox version had left its own launcher entry behind.
- Linux (Flatpak): Fixed signing in from the browser not returning to the app.
- Linux: Fixed a new tray icon being added every time Settings were saved.
- Linux (GNOME Wayland): Fixed the maximized window shrinking the first time it lost focus.
- Linux (GNOME): Fixed Rambox showing as "is ready" with a "1" badge in Dash to Panel.
- Linux (Hyprland, Sway): Fixed the Command Center and the tray panel closing when the mouse moved over the main window.
- Console: Fixed signing in to the desktop app through the console using the account already signed in in the browser, instead of the one you chose.
- Console: Fixed the year missing from invoice and billing dates in the organization overview.
- Console: Fixed a tab opened before an update failing to load pages.
- Sign-in: Fixed Google, Facebook and Microsoft sign-in not working in Firefox, and a sign-in popup closed without finishing now shows a message instead of an endless spinner.
- Sign-in: Fixed the sign-in page continuing with a session from a different account (personal vs. company).
- Sign-in: Fixed a tab opened before an update failing to load pages.
- Emails: Fixed satisfaction surveys not being sent for recently solved requests.
Known bugs
- Windows: installing a new version manually over an existing one unpins Rambox from the taskbar. Automatic updates are not affected.
- Linux (Snap): signing in from the browser may not return to the app if another Rambox registered the rambox:// link before. Workaround: xdg-mime default rambox_rambox.desktop x-scheme-handler/rambox.
